about: The farm app suite: one list of apps for every app's 'Farm apps' menu. Master copy: herd-planner/brand/suite-apps.json. Set an app's url when it goes live; null shows 'Coming soon'. 'company' is the company site every app links back to (top left and the top of this menu); change its name and url here when the company is named. 'account' is the suite's one account page (farm-account), linked at the top of this menu in every app but itself.
